How to read this comparison

Real cross-city analysis must align observation periods, cloud masks, spatial scale, and geographic boundaries. Weather and acquisition dates affect satellite temperatures. These sample values demonstrate the interface only.

BEHIND THE MAP

PLANNED WORKFLOW

From satellite to insight

  1. Collect

    Landsat surface temperature and reflectance, national land-cover data, and city boundaries.

  2. Prepare

    Mask clouds, align observation periods, calculate NDVI, and aggregate to a common grid.

  3. Train

    Compare random forest regression with a linear regression baseline.

  4. Evaluate

    Use spatially separated test areas and hold out cities to measure transfer performance.

Data sources & interpretation

Boundary source: U.S. Census TIGERweb ACS 2024 incorporated places. Planned heat-analysis sources: USGS Landsat, MRLC land cover, and Census boundaries. Temperature and land-cover sources are not yet connected to this prototype.

Satellite land surface temperature describes the surface at observation time. It is not a direct measure of air temperature, health risk, or personal heat exposure. NYC and Philadelphia use ACS 2024 city limits. The Los Angeles region combines 42 surrounding municipalities and enclosed terrestrial gaps; it is a custom study area, not an official metro boundary. Ocean, lakes, and rivers mapped in Census TIGERweb Areal Hydrography are excluded from all cells and land-based summaries. Small or unmapped water features may remain. Download the study-area definition and source metadata. Full cells are approximately 500 × 500 m (0.25 km²); edge cells are smaller. These are analysis cells, not street blocks. Denser display does not imply finer satellite measurement resolution. Summaries are weighted by mapped land area. The heat layer is not live weather: all current values are synthetic and have no observation date. The planned research will use historical summer observations with clearly displayed acquisition dates or compositing periods. Satellite basemap photos are geographic context and need not match those dates.
